title: update
description: promptscope update --json, from the Go updater. On failure the string field error is added. That field is not the contract error envelope.

latest.description: Latest release version, or null when the release could not be read.

asset.description: Release asset name, or null when the release could not be read.

installPath.description: Symlink path before a release is known, otherwise the versioned path the updater would install.

error.description: Present only when the update failed. Omitted on success. Never null.
